rows.title: RL-150 backlog closed by convergence: #90 restart + #91 -a targeting / down --volumes
rows.target: this ledger row (closure record; closes round-4 RL-150 without editing the closed ledger) + divergence 0028 addendum (file + registry.json notes)
rows.edit_sketch: #90 restart = canon's exact definition: full down pass then full up pass over the same per-app loop, volumes always preserved, confirms first, up pass unconditional on down failures, combined failure report, non-zero exit. #91: repeatable -a/--app on all three verbs (basename filter over enumerated app dirs; unknown name errors before anything runs) + down --volumes (per-app -v; prompt states data loss; up/restart reject it). Matches canon point for point; canon validated, unchanged. 0028 resolution note gains a dated addendum so 'residuals filed as RL-150' does not read as still-open.
rows.notes: Closes RL-150 (round-4 ledger, untouched). No Scind PR: annotation beneath threshold, consistent with round-4 pure-convergence precedent.

rows.title: ADR-0023 literal wording stale: workspace verbs now accept --app (as a loop filter)
rows.edit_sketch: ADR read 'does not accept --workspace NAME or --app NAME' — literally false since #91. Dated clarification paragraph: -a filters the per-app pass loop inside a workspace already located by walk-up/[DIR]; no name→location resolution; unknown name = error against enumerated dirs, not a registry lookup. Decision substance unchanged.
rows.notes: #91's spec text already cross-referenced ADR-0023 and divergence 0021 correctly; only the ADR itself lagged.

rows.title: Divergence 0021 re-audit: -a does not trigger the revisit condition — STILL-JUSTIFIED
rows.edit_sketch: Full re-check: revisit condition is 'Xcind adds a name→location registry' — #91 adds none; workspace discovery stays location-only. Canon-neutrality sentence holds (Scind registry = coherent superset). Re-stamped 2026-08-08 round-5: STILL-JUSTIFIED. Wording refreshed 'zero targeting flags' → 'zero name-targeting flags' + loop-filter carve-out so the entry stays literally true.
rows.notes: Only standing divergence this round's inputs could touch; the other 19 Active Design/Scope entries keep their round-2/3 stamps (yq fix is §5 substrate territory).

rows.title: 1357d8a (#89) yq-portability fix: no drift — eng-docs do not describe the expression
rows.edit_sketch: Host-gateway env-detection yq expression made jq-portable (tag→type both spellings; sub separator ,→;) so kislyuk/yq stops silently failing. High-drift area, so checked: grep confirms no eng-doc describes the expression internals; documented behavior (inject XCIND_HOST_GATEWAY unless present) was the intent — the fix repairs it under one yq flavor. Go canon parses YAML natively; permanent Go-vs-Bash substrate (§5).
rows.notes: No doc, canon, or registry impact.
